pushup.insufficient_depth.what: You're not reaching a full push-up depth.
pushup.insufficient_depth.why: Stopping short of a 90° elbow bend gives your chest and triceps less time under tension, making the push-up less effective.
pushup.insufficient_depth.whatToChange: Lower until your elbows reach roughly 90°, or your chest nears the floor, before pushing back up.
pushup.insufficient_depth.cue: Chest to the floor, not just your head.
pushup.insufficient_depth.drill: Push-ups to a target (a small object under your chest) so you get consistent feedback on depth.

pushup.hip_sag.what: Your hips are sagging during the push-up.
pushup.hip_sag.why: Letting the hips drop breaks the straight-body plank position, shifting load into your lower back instead of your core and chest.
pushup.hip_sag.whatToChange: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep a straight line from shoulders to ankles.
pushup.hip_sag.cue: Body like a plank, not a banana.
pushup.hip_sag.drill: Hold a plank for 20-30 seconds right before your push-up set to prime the same bracing pattern.
